
Trends
================================================================================

Row {.tabset}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Abundance

```{r}
plot_trend(pop$abundance, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, ylab = tinyAM:::.unit_label(pop$abundance, "Abundance"))
```

### Recruitment

```{r}
plot_trend(pop$recruitment, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, ylab = tinyAM:::.unit_label(pop$recruitment, "Recruitment"))
```

### SSB

```{r}
plot_trend(pop$ssb, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, ylab = tinyAM:::.unit_label(pop$ssb, ssb_label))
```

### Abundance-at-age

```{r}
plot_age_year(pop$N, color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, frame = ~age, ylab = tinyAM:::.unit_label(pop$N, "N"))
```

### Population patterns

```{r}
patterns <- tabs$patterns$population
if (is.data.frame(patterns) && nrow(patterns)) {
  patterns$model <- factor(patterns$model, levels = c(
    names(fits)[vapply(fits, inherits, logical(1), "tam_fit")],
    names(fits)[!vapply(fits, inherits, logical(1), "tam_fit")]))
  plot_matrix(patterns, metric = ~metric, frame = ~model)
} else {
  cat("Population patterns are unavailable for these reference outputs.")
}
```

### Average F


### F-at-age

```{r}
F <- mortality_plot_data(pop$F, pop$mu_F, fits, "F")
plot_age_year(F, plot = plot_mortality,
  color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols, frame = ~age, ylab = tinyAM:::.unit_label(F, "F"))
```

### Selectivity

```{r}
plot_age_year(pop$S, x = ~age, xlab = "Age", ylab = "Selectivity", frame = ~year,
           color = ~model, legendgroup = ~model, colors = cols)
```
